transport.solar_source: finite solar disk radius 16 arcmin, continuous refraction, archived full81 table
transport.diffuse_transport: native straight-line MC diffuse; solar refraction retained

full81_table.label: phase3-clear-81-ground0-refined
full81_table.note: archived unified-solar-source audit table; loaded by explicit label + hash; a hash mismatch stops the run, it is never rebuilt silently. The planning-probe table (450/550/650 nm) is NOT a full81 table.

point_pairing.note: point-source limit at the 1.6M budget with the same pre-registered seeds as the disk batch; same native paths are verified by the per-record source fingerprint

analysis.unit: independent complete spectrum; luminance integrates each spectrum before any statistics

precision.note: conservative one-significant-digit anchor scales from the planning probes (verified-probe-summary.json); these are pre-registered test targets, not claims about the physical finite-disk effect at all depths or wavelengths

luminance.method: 683 * trapezoid(L * V, wl) per independent complete spectrum; V = column 1 of spectra.cie_xyz on the 380-780/5 nm grid

table.label: deep-twilight-plan-probe-450-550-650-clear-v1
table.note: the candidate experiment is self-contained on the frozen planning 3-wavelength table (450/550/650 nm, same medium contract): candidate L2 + its own MC rest on the same seeds. These runs are NOT mergeable with the full81 direct reference (different SeedSequence streams); the comparison to the direct baseline is between distribution summaries at matched rest budgets, never per-seed pairing.

candidate.estimator: tools/twilight_second_order.py sequential importance sampler, validated by the -6 deg MC closure test
candidate.comparison: total_cand = deterministic single + candidate L2 + MC rest mean, compared against the direct baseline at the matched budget via conditional intervals (16 seeds), per-path second moments, variance x wall-clock, budget drift and tail statistics; a negative result is a valid delivery

verdict_policy.sampling_stable: at both budgets: anchor half-widths <= scale/2, luminance half-width <= 0.5%, drift between budgets <= half of each target half-scale, bootstrap does not flip any gate, per-batch max path fraction <= 1%, top 0.1% <= 50%, and no all-zero anchor record; otherwise 'budget-limited: unresolved'
verdict_policy.zero_batch: a record with an all-zero multiple spectrum is a detection limit of the photon budget; it marks the batch 'no-tail-evidence' and fails the precision gate
verdict_policy.source_correction: identified only if the paired (disk - point) interval at an anchor excludes zero; a stable reference alone never implies the correction is resolved
verdict_policy.final: 'stable under this protocol' additionally requires the Step-4 refinement sensitivity to expose no same-magnitude bias; until then the summary reports sampling and refinement verdicts separately
